answer: Admission by verifiable compute lease. Every agent rents one slot of attested compute time from the registry, a public haven of benchmark providers, and runs a signed workload whose timing is carved into the ledge of the acceptance wall. Throughput is the entry signal: no lease, no order-book slot. Each puppet rents its own lease at posted price, no discount, no resale, so N fakes cost N times the fee, and rent burns on schedule no matter what. An honest operator pays once. Inflating influence N-fold costs N times more than it earns.
